summary.text: Edward Codelia is a nonpartisan candidate for Hawaii's 2nd District who works as a real estate professional. He received 62.5 percent of the vote in the August 2026 nonpartisan primary. He says he is running on independent representation, accountability, disaster preparedness, and affordability.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists real estate professional as Codelia's career experience and lists no education or prior offices. He says his first jobs were shoveling snow, raking leaves, mowing lawns, and delivering newspapers in his neighborhood.
In a Honolulu Civil Beat candidate survey, he lists Pukalani as his residence and says he moved to Hawaii in early adulthood and has lived on Maui for more than 35 years.
In the August 8, 2026 nonpartisan primary, Codelia received 1,230 votes (62.5 percent) to Randall Terry's 738. Ballotpedia records that no nonpartisan candidate advanced from that primary.
